notes.title: Game Release Jan 4th
notes.notes: Hey everybody! I hope you enjoyed Modern Road-Like. I know I talked previously about releasing a game called 30 floors. Well, as I worked on it that game slowly changed into a different game: PsyOps Solutions (It is currently on the Steam Store if you want to check it out). As it looks now it should release on Jan 4th. As an update (probably in Feburary) I will be incorporating a 30 floors type of level/mission. I put alot of time and hard work Into PsyOps Solutions to make it a tribute to old school JRPGs. I am also thinking about working on a Modern Road-Like 2, but am unsure at this time if I am going to go through with it. I'd like to extend a thank you to everyone who purchased the game for your support. It means alot to me, and its fueling my current activities as I learn programming. You all are great!

notes.title: Hope everyone enjoyed the game
notes.notes: Thank you all for the support and I hope you all enjoyed this game (as well as the updates). Just another week until my next game (Open Space 2-D) comes out and the game I’ve been working hardest on (30 floors) should be out in the next 4 weeks! Leave a review if you liked this game or hated it, I can always use the feedback to improve my games. Thanks again everyone.
